newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares soar to all-time closing high.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares soar to all-time closing high.

text.p: Norwegian shares jumped to a record close on Monday with oil companies Norsk Hydro and Saga Petroleum being boosted by the strong dollar but volume was thin, dealers said.
The Total share index ended at 1,173.01 points, up 1.28 percent and beating the previous record close of 1,166.66 set on May 29. Turnover was just 740 million crowns.
"Hydro and Saga are up on the strong dollar and the oil market looks fine ahead," a dealer said. "The French election had no impact on the Oslo Bourse."
Hydro, Norway's largest listed company, was the most traded share at 66 million crowns, closing 1.97 percent higher at 363 crowns.
Saga's A share rose 3.83 percent to 149 crowns in turnover of 39 million crowns.
Ocean Rig jumped 8.02 percent to 8.75 crowns in turnover of 50 million crowns on reports that an oil company is close to signing a rig deal with the offshore group, dealers said.
